full_judgment: 4. The facts contended in the said suit, in brief, is that there is a pond in the suit property appertaining to C.S Khatian no. 183 and S.A Khatian No.1 and C.S Plot no. 321 and S.A Plot no.649 measuring 0.32 acre in Mouza Satpai within Netrokona Pourashava. Plaintiffs maternal grandfather Momruz Kha had been residing in his residence located in the land appertaining to plot no. 320 of C.S Khatian no. 665. The suit land was situated adjacent to the residence of plaintiffs grandfather's said residence and he had been possessing the suit land as palan land to his homestead within knowledge of everybody. Plaintiffs maternal grandfather Momruz Kha gifted the suit land orally to plaintiff. The defendants never had or have got any right, title and possession over the suit land. But the S.A record has been prepared wrongly in the name of Government. Plaintiff got her residence constructed on the land appertaining to plot no. 645 which is adjacent to the suit land. Om 08.07.1999 plaintiff came to know about such wrong record of right and then she instituted the suit. Defendant no.5 has got no right, title and possession over the suit land.
